{{Short description|Annual association football award event in France}} {{Use dmy dates|date=June 2024}} {{Infobox award | name = 2009 Ballon d'Or | subheader = | image = Messi Training (cropped).jpg | image_size = | alt = | caption = 2009 Ballon d'Or winner, Lionel Messi | awarded_for = | date = {{start date|2009|12|01|df=y}} | location = [[Paris]], France | country = France | presenter = ''[[France Football]]'' | host = | former name = | preshow_host = | acts = | website = {{URL|ballondor.com}} | runtime = | award1_type = Won by | award1_winner = {{flagicon|ARG}} [[Lionel Messi]] (1st award) | previous = [[2008 Ballon d'Or|2008]] | main = [[Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2010 FIFA Ballon d'Or|2010]] }} The '''2009 Ballon d'Or''' ({{lit|'''2009 Golden Ball'''}}), given to the best [[Association football|football]] player in the world as judged by an international panel of sports journalists, was awarded to [[Lionel Messi]] of [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] on 1 December 2009, the first of his [[Ballon d'Or#Wins by player|record setting]] eight Ballon d'Or awards.{{Cite web |title=Classement 2009 |url=http://www.francefootball.fr/Ballon_Or_2012/bo_2009.php |language=fr |work=[[France Football]] |publisher=Groupe Amaury |access-date=10 January 2013 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121116005111/http://www.francefootball.fr/Ballon_Or_2012/bo_2009.php |archive-date=16 November 2012}} Messi won the award by a then record margin, 240 points ahead of [[2008 Ballon d'Or|2008]] winner [[Cristiano Ronaldo]]. [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]] was the second Barcelona player in the top three, finishing a further 63 points behind Ronaldo. Messi's win made him the first Argentine-born player to win the award since [[Omar Sívori]] in 1961; however, Sívori had taken Italian citizenship by that time and is recognised to have won the [[Ballon d'Or]] as an Italian player. == Rankings == {| class="wikitable" !Rank !Player !Nationality !Club(s) !Points |- style="background-color: #FFF68F; font-weight: bold;" |align="center"|1 |[[Lionel Messi]] |{{flag|Argentina}} |{{fbaicon|ESP}} [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] |align="center"|473 |- |align="center"|2 |[[Cristiano Ronaldo]] |{{flag|Portugal}} |{{fbaicon|ENG}} [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]]
